findings.title: I16-F not met: evidence/candidate5/sim-reference/actual-inspection.json records only public https://www.sim.ai/workflows and /logs marketing pages (/chat is 404, /workspace redirects to /login); sim-install.log fails building isolated-vm; sim-schema-push.log fails Postgres code 42704; sim-local-browser*.log show 60s page.goto timeouts and empty pages (sim-local-entry.json text="", buttons=[]). There are 0 image files under evidence/candidate5 and no 'Sim -> DevFlower' comparison table. F1 (actual editor/canvas/toolbar/inspector/navigation inspection, not marketing pages or README) and F5 (side-by-side screenshots; actual canvas drag/connect/node-config/IO-inspector/close tests) are missing; tests/workbench_browser.py is Chromium synthetic fixture work and does not satisfy F1/F5.

Source robustness defect: tools/studio/workbench_scheduler.py:125 (run_graph) and tools/studio/workbench_scheduler.py:286 (execute_node) catch only (Blocked, Invalid, OSError, ValueError, KeyError), and tools/studio/workbench_worker.py:14-19 has no top-level handler. Executable counterexample reviews/r1/scratch/worker_exit_counterexample.py (`cd /tmp/i16r1 && python3 -I -B worker_exit_counterexample.py`) raises RuntimeError from the executor: it escapes to the worker main (worker exit 1), leaves run.state=RUNNING, finished_at=None, activation STARTING/RUNNING and result PENDING - the same persisted signature as evidence/candidate5/native/{merge,route-code,route-research}/final.json. Catch Exception/BaseException at worker level, persist RECOVERY_REQUIRED/FAILED with the error class, stop owned processes, and never leave a dead worker behind a RUNNING run.

Real-run acceptance evidence is incomplete/failed: evidence/candidate5/native/merge/final.json run 46e4c6ea8cd63f7d813d6d46a7c06649 state=RECOVERY_REQUIRED with run.state=RUNNING and summary agent RUNNING (input_sent_sha256 present, no receipt); native/route-code/final.json run 5e5ab0eb74b6b3c9bacb7b6874c05c9d state=RECOVERY_REQUIRED, classifier chose label=code (confidence 0.95, elapsed_ms=22650.989, reason recorded) but the code agent ended RUNNING with input_sent_sha256 and no receipt; native/route-research/final.json run 09d1cc3f10df19d991d5bfc216aebdc5 state=RECOVERY_REQUIRED with router RUNNING and no decision. known-status.json states three UI-started workers exited 1 and the cause is undiagnosed; no worker stdout/stderr or exit-code artifact is present. Therefore E5 (two-agent merge end-to-end plus real condition-branch selection and deterministic routing failure) and E6 (classification routed to a target Agent that actually completed) are not demonstrated. Rerun sequentially with worker stdout/stderr captured.

I16-JEV identity verification unproven: docs/WORKBENCH.md:75 and evidence/candidate5/classifier-benchmark/results.json ('jev': available=false, n=0, accuracy=null, latency=null) assert 'TypeSafe System One' and a Choice API but contain no cited project/model URL, license, deployment requirements or interface artifact, and no Jev measurement. The generic comparison is present (deterministic, local tiny classifier, generic LLM router; 10 fixed synthetic tasks covering code/research/writing/debug/review; confusion matrices, mean/p50/p95 ms, fallback ratios). Supply the cited Jev identity/license/deployment/interface evidence or a measured Jev arm; do not substitute another LLM for Jev.

Compiled bytecode is inside the frozen source: tools/studio/__pycache__/workbench_server.cpython-312.pyc (sha256 3d9882f1013edfcbd4fbba0cf2d2dd989f66051f662c7ebc3caf242b283bc3d6, 16084 bytes) is listed in candidate-manifest.json and added by changes.diff although .gitignore excludes __pycache__/ and *.py[cod]. Remove it and refreeze (candidate_sha256 changes); a version-specific .pyc can shadow source when mtime/size match and is not reviewable source.

tools/studio/workbench_ui/index.jsx:224 nests a focusable role=button SVG (the X close control, tabIndex=0, aria-label) inside each <button> session-tab. Nested interactive controls are invalid ARIA and ambiguous for keyboard/screen-reader users (the inner onKeyDown only handles Enter/Space). Move close to a sibling button or use a non-interactive icon plus a distinct close control while preserving the current Escape/focus-restore behaviour required by I16-B.

limitations: Identity verified independently: all 163 files in reviews/r1/candidate-manifest.json hash-match the candidate tree; sha256(canonical(files)) = a688b2fb755f9d01d8ceb0354b7b61ab94ec81722cbbc9c02dbabe3e5edf202d; sha256(contract.txt) = dffdbc0bd1fb254e89ade0e8bcfefe0031a94f49673b0ed2df3233ea6f560467; all 18 evidence/candidate5/regression log hashes match regression/results.json.

Review-host limits: /usr/bin/bwrap exists but cannot create user namespaces ('bwrap: No permissions to create new namespace'); no Chromium/Playwright module; ~/.codex and ~/.claude are absent (no credentials); node is v18.19.1 while the executor used v22.14.0. Real-model sessions, Claude proxy /v1/models discovery, browser suites and the UI rebuild therefore could not be independently rerun on this host; recorded executor evidence was inspected and hash-checked, but it is not personal user acceptance.

Independent Python run on this host: `cd <candidate> && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v` -> 500 tests, 3 failures + 1 error, all environment-only: tests/test_workspace_sessions.py:210 AF_UNIX path too long (deep candidate path), and tests/test_usable.py isolation-probe/bwrap cases because unprivileged user namespaces are unavailable. The executor's regression/python.log records 500/500 OK. An external bwrap-capable runner must rerun the full suite.

Independent live Codex discovery through the candidate code (scratch/live_discovery.py, real /usr/local/bin/codex 0.146.0, empty HOME, no credentials): ModelCatalog.get(refresh=True) returned 5 real models (gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.2), source='Codex app-server model/list', stale=false, discovery_complete=true, error=null, authentication.logged_in=false (honest), physical_backend='unknown'. This verifies the real discovery/refresh/effort/error-label path but not the full bwrap/operator-profile UI flow. Claude proxy discovery was not live-tested (no operator settings/credentials) and no live full-account catalog artifact from the executor exists.

Real native sessions rely on recorded evidence: evidence/candidate5/native-chat/{codex,claude}/latest.json show state=COMPLETED, process.exit=0, exact session UUIDs and requested model/effort (codex resolved_model/resolved_effort unknown is honest). They could not be rerun here (no credentials).

Failed-run root cause is not established: no worker stdout/stderr or exit-code artifact is present. The counterexample proves the missing catch-all can produce the observed RUNNING + dead-worker signature but does not prove the actual trigger (RecursionError/sqlite3.Error/MemoryError/other). known-status.json asserts 'diagnostic_serial_claude exit0' and 'diagnostic_parallel_claude 3-call merge exit0' without artifacts; those unbacked claims were not used as acceptance.

Sim reference: zero image files exist under evidence/candidate5; only public marketing pages plus a failed/empty local Sim app are recorded (install fails on isolated-vm, DB schema fails 42704, page.goto timeouts/empty page). F1/F5 (real editor inspection, Sim -> DevFlower comparison table, side-by-side screenshots, actual canvas/close tests) are unmet; no personal UX acceptance exists.

Rebuild not independently verified: static/workbench.js and static/workbench.css do contain the new components (escaped Chinese strings present) and .github/workflows/usable.yml defines an `npm ci` + `node build.mjs` + `git diff --exit-code` step, but no rebuild artifact/log is in evidence and this sandbox has no UI dependency cache/network. External command: `mkdir -p /tmp/wb && cp tools/studio/workbench_ui/package.json tools/studio/workbench_ui/package-lock.json /tmp/wb/ && npm ci --prefix /tmp/wb --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && DEVFLOWER_UI_DEPS=/tmp/wb node tools/studio/workbench_ui/build.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- tools/studio/static/workbench.js tools/studio/static/workbench.css tools/studio/workbench_ui/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt`.

Browser suites for a controlled external runner: `python3 tests/workbench_browser.py --chromium <chrome> --node <node> --playwright-module <candidate>/tests/browser_driver.cjs --artifacts <out>` and the same pattern for session_browser.py, workspace_browser.py, usable_browser.py, template_browser.py, studio_races.py, studio_identity_races.py. The recorded suites (45 workbench checks, 32 session checks, etc.) use synthetic native data; they are not real-model or personal-UX acceptance.

User personal UX acceptance (contract I16-E10) remains pending and was not invented; the native-terminal proof actor is 'Codex-operated actual Studio and native Codex PTY; not personal user acceptance'. The actor is an agent, not the user.

No merge, Stable promotion, force-push, session deletion or Git authority is granted. The fixed old Gate was not executed; it runs only after an independent hard ACCEPT using this report as input, and this verdict is NEEDS_CORRECTION, so no Gate/CI/Stable claim is made.

I16-JEV is BLOCKED only for its mandatory identity/license/deployment/interface verification evidence; the generic Router interface and the 10-task comparison are present. I16-E1's Codex path was live-verified; the Claude proxy path was verified only by source and unit tests.
